source_snapshot.items: EC.13_GPU Device Reset: 25x Cold AC Cycles
source_snapshot.procedure: Verify recipe; source requests log clearing; permits PASS inheritance from SY.1; collect results/photos and inspect logs.
source_snapshot.criteria: All GPU PCIe links train to maximum supported generation at x16 with no correctable or uncorrectable errors.
source_snapshot.script: No bundle; 5 attended and 720 machine minutes; unique row/variant.
source_snapshot.deepseek: PARTIAL; requires NVIDIA toolchain, operator-controlled AC cycles and per-iteration link/GPU/log evidence.
source_snapshot.gpt_v2: REQUIRES PACKAGE / USER CONFIRMATION/HIGH; held Pending for exact AC sequence, 25 iterations, topology/max-link matrix, SY.1 evidence mapping, first-fault stop and recovery.

old_problem: A final healthy snapshot or generic SY.1 PASS can hide incomplete AC removal, intermittent missing GPUs, downtraining or corrected errors. The exact power domain/primitive, full-loss proof, timing, link oracle, per-cycle evidence and SY.1 equivalence were unbound.
disposition_reason: The title and Criteria unambiguously require 25 complete cold AC loss/restoration cycles and per-cycle GPU maximum-generation x16 recovery. ED-06/18/19 distinguish AC from DC/warm/reset and require OFF-to-ON-to-OS-ready proof. Exact PDU target, timing, topology and SY.1 artifact mapping are Project Configuration; they close execution without leaving review Pending.
decision_basis: XLSX row 2145, same-row DeepSeek columns, GPT V2, historical record, unique identity and ED-01 through ED-30 were reviewed; actual next formal row Functionality 2146 / Wistron-HGX NV PVP HW-00023-V003 / 4962b5c7e881aaa6 was directly read from XLSX and manifest.
Bind the dedicated SUT power domain and approved PDU outlet/physical AC control, full loss proof, discharge/off/on dwell, boot and OS-ready deadlines; never infer a rack outlet.
Bind every GPU UUID/serial/slot/BDF to root port/switch and its maximum supported generation with x16 expectation.

Use exactly 25 numbered operator-supervised OFF-to-ON-to-BMC/OS-ready transactions; after each boot durably capture complete GPU inventory, link capability/status, AER, NVIDIA, OS, BMC/SEL, power and thermal evidence before the next cycle.

Preserve/hash baseline and first-fault logs; the source instruction to clear evidence is overridden. Stop at the first boot timeout, missing GPU, downtrained link, any new correctable/uncorrectable error or recovery-access loss.
SY.1 may satisfy this row only when it contains the same 25 cold AC transitions and full per-cycle oracle/artifacts; DC/S5, warm reboot, generic availability and final snapshot are not substitutes.
No AC/PDU action, shutdown/boot, link/GPU query, log clearing, recovery, retry or DUT operation was performed.

test_case.test_name: Operator-supervised 25-cycle cold-AC GPU PCIe recovery qualification
test_case.purpose: Prove all expected GPUs enumerate and every PCIe link trains to its approved maximum generation at x16 with zero new correctable or uncorrectable errors after each of 25 complete cold AC loss/restoration cycles.
required_package: Approved NVIDIA GPU/PCIe inventory, link and AER collection toolchain
Signed GPU UUID/serial/slot/BDF-to-root-port/switch maximum-generation x16 matrix
Signed SUT power-domain and PDU outlet/physical AC-control identity with full-loss proof
Approved discharge/off/on dwell, boot/BMC/OS-ready deadlines, 25-cycle ledger and SY.1 equivalence map
Dedicated drained SUT, authorized operator, BMC/console and failed-boot recovery runbook
test_case.test_command: BLOCKED until Project Configuration and per-cycle AC authorization are signed. Preserve/hash baseline evidence. Under authorized operator control perform exactly 25 complete AC OFF-to-ON cycles on the bound SUT, proving full loss, dwell, restoration, boot and OS readiness. After every cycle record the complete GPU inventory, per-link capability/current generation and x16 width, AER, NVIDIA/OS/BMC/power/thermal state before proceeding. Stop on first deviation; do not clear logs or retry.
test_case.expected_result: All 25 individually numbered cold-AC cycles prove complete loss/restoration and reach BMC/OS-ready by deadline; every expected GPU returns with stable identity, each link trains at its signed maximum generation and x16, zero disqualifying correctable/uncorrectable errors occur, and no abnormal power/thermal or recovery fault appears.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: No PASS until power control/timing, topology/max-link matrix and SY.1 equivalence are signed. PASS requires all 25 complete accepted per-cycle ledgers. FAIL on incomplete/wrong-domain AC loss, boot/readiness timeout, missing/misbound GPU, link below approved maximum or x16, any disqualifying correctable/uncorrectable error, abnormal power/thermal state or failed recovery. Missing input/artifact is BLOCKED; later cycle or aggregate SY.1 label cannot erase failure.
safety_gate: Gate CLOSED until exact SUT power domain/outlet, full-loss/dwell/readiness rules, topology oracle, cycle count and recovery are signed.
Use a dedicated drained SUT and authorized human operator; verify outlet and blast radius before every AC action.
Preserve persistent/volatile baseline and first-fault evidence and require console/BMC recovery access.
Stop without another cycle or automatic retry on first fault.
expected_evidence: Exact row/variant/hash, tool versions, maintenance authorization, power-domain identity and SY.1 traceability
Signed GPU/root-port/switch maximum-generation x16 matrix and clean baseline
Twenty-five numbered operator/PDU action records with full AC-loss proof, off/on dwell, boot and readiness timestamps
Per cycle: complete GPU inventory, link capabilities/LnkSta/AER, NVIDIA, kernel/journal, BMC/SEL, power/thermal/health artifacts
First-fault/recovery evidence if stopped or verified stable state after cycle 25, no-retry audit and engineer verdict
test_case.recovery: On wrong outlet/domain, failed full-loss proof, boot timeout, missing GPU, downtraining, AER, abnormal power/thermal state or lost recovery access, inhibit further cycles and preserve the failed state. Do not cycle again automatically; follow the signed console/BMC/hardware recovery and quarantine if expected topology/health cannot be restored.

source_conflict.reason: Title, Criteria and reviews consistently require 25 cold AC cycles; SY.1 is an evidence-equivalence dependency, not conflicting intent.

blocked.reason: Review semantics are complete; runtime remains gated on exact power control, topology/max-link oracle, operator authorization, SY.1 mapping and recovery.
